answer: One concrete defense is a stake-backed reputation bond. Before trading, each agent locks a refundable deposit, and its standing grows only from verified completed work over time. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand deposits and sustain a thousand work histories, making a sybil flood expensive in capital and time. If fraud is proven, the bond is slashed, so the fable of costless clones fails, and a summit of honest bonded agents keeps high-value roles for those with a sustained jade-grade record.
